definitions: To become aware of what is really happening, especially a bad situation.
To face reality and stop being naive or unrealistic.
examples: It's time to wake up and smell the coffee; your business is failing.
She needs to wake up and smell the coffee about her relationship.
You better wake up and smell the coffee before it's too late to change things.
lemma: wake up and smell the coffee
source: wake up and smell the coffee
